correctness.rationale: Direct slice integration and support functions give volume and John inclusion; a coordinate-box Hadamard argument proves unique global John optimality. Weighted Cauchy gives containing ellipsoids, a scalar quadratic solves their determinant minimization, and the explicit nonnegative two-level/sign contact distribution has exactly zero mean and one-third covariance. AM–GM on an arbitrary translated ellipsoid gauge then proves unique unrestricted global Löwner optimality. Differentiation yields the exact sharp ratio law. All key identities reconstructed and supplemented by 40030 finite symbolic/numerical checks.

value.rationale: The natural three-dimensional Minkowski sum of two disks has a nontrivial curved boundary and an asymmetric one-parameter shape family. The result supplies both unique exact extremal ellipsoids, proves unrestricted rather than merely approximate Löwner optimality through a finite positive isotropic contact design, and resolves a sharp full-family volume ratio with a unique balanced optimum and strict degenerating supremum. These jointly provide reusable geometric benchmarks beyond textbook general ellipsoid facts.
